inputs.text: A ceasefire that leaves Tehran with more leverage over the Strait of Hormuz is no lasting peace; it risks teaching that force and pressure pay. The five counter-conditions show the sides remain far apart, and Israel must not be denied the means to protect its people from future threats. America should stand firm for security and order, not bless coercion. When leaders fail to defend vital interests, it is ordinary families and nations that bear the danger.
